title: Saturation Overload
description: Eating more than you should can't be good for you
body:
Food taste yummy, but my stomach feel fuzzy

Make for modpack with saturation plus or similar mod that make the saturation limit higher (or remove it completly) and apply debuff depending on the amount of excess saturation you have. Meant to counter the fact that some food mod have food that can be eaten without being hungry and can therocaly give infinite saturation.
